expectationBasis: The repository overview identifies the repository in a heading containing “owner/repository name”, displays a visible “Public” marker for a public repository, and provides a navigation link “Code”.

THEN: The overview page displays “owner/repository name”, the Public marker, description, default branch, and file list, and provides entries such as “Code”, “Issues”, and “Pull requests”; the visitor can click a file name to enter the file-content page.
Users open a repository overview from global search results, a personal/organization Repositories list, or a direct link;
A seeded public repository with its matching name and stable address is readable without sign-in and retains the same heading after reload.

THEN: After refreshing or reopening through the same address, the same repository state is still displayed; if the address is replaced with that of a private repository for which the visitor has no authorization, its content is not shown to the visitor.

After visibility or access grants change, search, lists, direct links, and repository pages must all use the same access rule.
